title: The South Pole's Drinking Well Becomes Its Toilet
asof: Figures as of 2026 · full video on the channel

shots.s: At the South Pole, your drinking water comes from a hole in the ice.
And one day, that hole becomes your toilet.
There's no river.
No lake.
And barely any snow falls.
About an inch a year.
So the station makes its own lake.
It's called a Rodwell.
Hot water is pumped down a hole in the ice.
It melts a pool several hundred feet down.
Then pumps pull that water back up.
The heat comes from the generators.
Heat that would otherwise be lost.
Every drop you drink was melted with it.
But after a few years,
when a Rodwell gets too big,
it gets a new job.
It becomes the sewage tank.
Yes.
Your old water well becomes your toilet.
Would you still drink the water?
